models_evaluated: DERM (Deep Ensemble for Recognition of Malignancy) version A

links.outcome: Real-world sensitivity and specificity versus pre-market performance and sensitivity targets
links.effect: Sensitivity 95.0-100.0% for melanoma and 96.0-100.0% for malignancy; benign specificity 40.7-49.4% (vA) and 70.1-73.4% (vB); 15.0-31.0% of cases eligible for discharge.
links.quote: We show DERM performance in-line with sensitivity targets and pre-marketing authorisation research, and it reduced the caseload for hospital specialists in two pathways.

unlisted_practices: Post-market surveillance elements for AI as a medical device

screen.reason: Prospective real-world clinical deployment evaluation of an AI tool (DERM) for skin lesion assessment across NHS hospitals, reporting diagnostic performance and workflow impact without experimentally testing a specific deployment safeguard/practice.
